secondary_process_variance_lane.rule: A separate outcome-blind simulation decides whether local process variance can support the decoupling-with-instability claim. Failure removes that claim but does not alter the primary response-filter test.

boundary: No real demographic count magnitude may be read, summarized, transformed or modeled.
The log1p transform is frozen before checking whether real count values include zeros.
No new predictor, radius, geographic partition or interaction may be introduced to rescue failure.
Species-specific image offsets remain diagnostic only.
